Name: GRAPHICS_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters used for various graphical settings.

Fields.Name: Decal Generation Position Offset on Bullet Hit
Fields.Description: When a bullet hits a HIT INS, the decal it generates is offset by this value along the surface normal.

Fields.Name: Torch: Emissive Strength
Fields.Description: The maximum emissive strength of the torch. It reaches this value over the fade frames.

Fields.Name: Torch: Emissive Strength Fade Frame
Fields.Description: The fade time when the torch's emissive strength is changed. 60 frames equals 1 second.

Fields.Name: Decal Fade Distance after Character is Wet
Fields.Description: The distance at which a decal is faded after a character is made wet.

Fields.Name: Multi-Hit Bullet: Particle Interval
Fields.Description: The interval between hit particle effects when a bullet hits multiple times. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Decal Paint Fade Out Duration
Fields.Description: The fade-out time of damage paint decals. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 0: 0 -> 0
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 0, level 0. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 0: 0 -> 1
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 0, levels 0-1. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 0: 1 -> 2
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 0, levels 1-2. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 0: 2 -> 3
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 0, levels 2-3. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 1: 0 -> 0
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 1, level 0. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 1: 0 -> 1
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 1, levels 0-1. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 1: 1 -> 2
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 1, levels 1-2. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 1: 2 -> 3
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 1, levels 2-3. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 2: 0 -> 0
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 2, level 0. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 2: 0 -> 1
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 2, levels 0-1. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 2: 1 -> 2
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 2, levels 1-2. In metres.

Fields.Name: Grass LOD 2: 2 -> 3
Fields.Description: Grass generator LOD distance, LOD set 2, levels 2-3. In metres.

Fields.Name: Sub-window Frame: Width
Fields.Description: The width of the sub-window. In pixels.

Fields.Name: Sub-window Frame: Height
Fields.Description: The height of the sub-window. In pixels.

Fields.Name: Menu Blur: Fade-in Duration
Fields.Description: Time until the background is blurred when a full-screen menu such as Assembly opens. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Menu Blur: Fade-out Duration
Fields.Description: Time until the background blur is removed after a full-screen menu such as Assembly is shown. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: Threshold Speed
Fields.Description: The threshold speed at which zoom blur occurs during boost movement. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: Interpolation Time
Fields.Description: The time until the zoom blur reaches its maximum value. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: Strength
Fields.Description: The strength of the zoom blur.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: Centre Reduction
Fields.Description: Reduces the zoom blur at the centre of the screen so the player's own AC is not blurred.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: Contrast
Fields.Description: The contrast value to apply to the zoom blur.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: UV Offset (Top of Screen)
Fields.Description: The UV offset applied by the zoom blur at the top of the screen.

Fields.Name: Zoom Blur: UV Offset (Bottom of Screen)
Fields.Description: The UV offset applied by the zoom blur at the bottom of the screen.

Fields.Name: Hit Particle Generation Limit
Fields.Description: Limit on the number of hit particle effects that can be generated. Works with Hit Particle Limit Distance.

Fields.Name: Hit Particle Limit Distance
Fields.Description: The distance used for the hit particle effect generation limit. In metres.

Fields.Name: Shadow: Fixed Angle of View
Fields.Description: Fixed field of view used for shadow rendering, in degrees. Prevents shadows from stretching into lines when the player keeps moving.
